name: buddy
description: Claude Code buddy plugin: Quack the ASCII duck waddles above your prompt and talks back — or bring back your /buddy

scripts.test: vitest run --dir tests && claude plugin test plugins/buddy
scripts.typecheck: npm run types && tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.hooks.json
scripts.validate:plugin: claude plugin validate --strict . && claude plugin validate --strict plugins/buddy
